summary: P1.13D.2 (Meelora Platform Context) — independent confirmation. Backend: 18/18 pytest assertions passed (login payload exposes platform_role for platform/support and null for julie; /api/platform/summary = 200 for platform_admin & support, 403 for julie and workspace admin; /api/platform/clients lists Meelora ws_56c4929..; all sub-resources /clients/{ws}/{overview|administrators|users|modules|logs|support} = 200; platform-scoped /api/platform/logs and tenant-scoped /clients/{ws}/logs are distinct endpoints; platform_admin token is properly rejected on workspace-admin-only /api/logs, confirming platform_role does NOT grant financial authority). Frontend E2E via Playwright over the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL: platform@meelora.com lands DEFAULT in Platform context (context-switcher visible with context-platform + context-company; platform-home + 4 stats platform-stat-{clients,companies,users,events}; nav-platform_{home,clients,logs} all present). Clicking nav-platform_clients shows 1 client row; opening it renders client-card with all 6 tabs client-tab-{overview,admins,users,modules,logs,support} and each activates its client-panel-*. Context switch to context-company reveals nav-budget and HIDES nav-platform_home (count 0); switching back to context-platform restores platform-home. Support user sees the switcher + platform-home. Julie sees NO context-switcher and NO nav-platform_home, only the financial app (nav-budget=1). Regression: admin@accslegro.com loads financial app with nav-budget + nav-access present and no switcher. Replace-admin dialog was NOT opened because the replace-admin-<companyId> button on Meelora is (by design, per iteration_59) DISABLED when there is no current admin to replace — same defensive UX as the previous console; the button and its testid are present. This is expected behavior, not a defect.
critical_code_review_comments: Good: platform_role gating is fail-closed on every /api/platform/* endpoint (verified with julie AND workspace admin tokens — both 403).
Good: strict log separation implemented as two distinct endpoints (/api/platform/logs vs /api/platform/clients/{ws}/logs); no aggregated stream endpoint exists.
Good: /auth/login now returns platform_role in the user payload so the context-switcher renders immediately after login (no refresh needed).

Nit / defensive UX: replace-admin-<companyId> button is currently disabled for Meelora because that company has no current admin. Consider adding a tooltip / helper text ('Aucun administrateur actuel à remplacer') so testers/QA/support don't think the button is broken.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 flows — replace-admin dialog gated by expected disabled state)

seed_data_creation: None. No throwaway users created (replace-admin flow blocked at button by defensive guard; not exercised end-to-end).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite for P1.13D.2 lives at /app/backend/tests/test_p1_13d2_platform_context.py (18 tests, pytest-xdist safe). It covers: login payload platform_role, /api/platform/summary gating (platform_admin/support = 200; julie/workspace-admin = 403), /api/platform/clients listing, all 6 sub-resources under /api/platform/clients/{WS}, both log endpoints, and the platform-role-is-not-financial-authority guard on /api/logs. Frontend flow is functionally green over the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. The only path not exercised end-to-end is the actual replace-admin mutation because the button is (correctly) disabled for the Meelora company — to exercise it, seed a company_membership with role=admin/principal for the target company first, then reload and click replace-admin-<companyId>.
rca of the issue: No defects observed. The single scripted 'failure' (T3 timeout) is the Playwright framework waiting for a disabled button to become enabled; this is the same defensive guard flagged & approved in iteration_59 (no current admin on Meelora => Continuer/Remplacer disabled).
